overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the Town Manager alone decided to hire special counsel for the Planning Board and told only two of five members, so no quorum deliberated.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated outside an open meeting to approve appointing special town counsel for the Planning Board.
allegations.key_passage: There was no communication between or among a quorum of the Board concerning this decision.
